sg.title: KDAN Open-Sources Core Products to Advance Enterprise AI Document Infrastructure and Data Sovereignty
sg.description: ComPDF and DottedSign are now available on GitHub with self-hosted deployment options, enabling enterprises to validate, deploy and scale AI-powered document workflows while maintaining control of sensitive data IRVINE, Calif. , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KDAN (TPEx: 7737), a global provider of AI document and data infrastructure, today announced the open-source release of core products ComPDF and DottedSign on GitHub, marking a major step in the company's global strategy to support enterprise AI adoption through open-source access and commercial licensing. Through this self-hosted, open-source model, KDAN aims to lower the barrier for enterprises seeking to adopt AI-powered document applications while creating a scalable path for commercial growth. The initiative responds to growing global demand for sovereign AI, self-hosted deployment and secure document infrastructure that allows organizations to retain control over sensitive information. Traditional enterprise software adoption often involves high implementation barriers, significant validation costs and lengthy procurement cycles. By open-sourcing core products, KDAN enables enterprise IT teams and developers to download core source code directly through GitHub and quickly deploy and use the solutions in self-hosted or private cloud environments without sending sensitive documents to third-party cloud services. KDAN's open-source projects adopt Open Source Initiative (OSI) approved licenses. The license terms, scope of use and commercial use conditions for each repository are subject to the LICENSE files published on GitHub. After completing validation, enterprises with advanced requirements for security governance, technical support, customized integration and long-term maintenance can upgrade to KDAN's enterprise commercial licensing offerings. These paid options include enterprise-grade security modules, global technical support, cross-system integration and long-term version maintenance, creating a full conversion path from open-source adoption to enterprise deployment. The strategy is especially relevant for financial services, manufacturing, government agencies and large enterprises that prioritize information security, compliance and data governance. By combining open-source access with commercial-grade enterprise services, KDAN is helping organizations accelerate AI innovation while maintaining compliance and control over their data. "KDAN is not competing with AI models. Instead, we serve as a 'charging station' that connects enterprise data with AI models," said Kenny Su, Founder and Chairman of KDAN. "Through core product open-sourcing and enterprise commercial licensing, we help enterprises train, access and apply document data more quickly, accurately and securely. By enabling organizations to maintain data autonomy, we are helping them build scalable AI document infrastructure while creating long-term business value for KDAN." KDAN continues to invest in product development across its two core product lines. ComPDF offers intelligent document parsing capabilities. In internal testing using the public OpenDataLab benchmark dataset and evaluation framework, ComPDF outperformed several mainstream open-source models in document recognition and table recognition tasks. The latest version of ComPDF achieved leading performance across multiple metrics, including Formula, Table, Text Parsing and Reading Order accuracy, demonstrating KDAN's long-term investment in AI document processing technology. Its open-source version provides core capabilities including document parsing, field extraction, API integration and self-hosted deployment for technical validation and basic implementation. The enterprise commercial licensing version further provides high-precision parsing, batch processing, access control, audit logs, system integration and long-term maintenance, supporting formal enterprise deployment and large-scale use. DottedSign's open-source version offers highly compatible APIs and a modular architecture, allowing enterprises to deploy the solution in self-hosted or private cloud environments and integrate it with existing ERP, HRM, CRM and other enterprise systems. Enterprises with advanced security, permission management, audit, customization and maintenance needs can upgrade to the enterprise commercial licensing version. Looking ahead, KDAN plans to extend this open-source and commercial licensing strategy to additional products and use cases, continuing to address long-term enterprise demand for data sovereignty and digital transformation. About KDAN KDAN (TPEx: 7737) is a global provider of AI document and data infrastructure for enterprises. Their modular architecture integrates document management, data extraction, and eSignature workflows, with flexible deployment options to fit diverse environments. They empower enterprises to adopt AI at scale across their systems and operations while maintaining data sovereignty and information security, ultimately driving sustainable business value. For more information, visit: KDAN Developer Solutions: https://www.kdan.com/kdan-developer ComPDF AI DocSlight: https://www.compdf.com/ai/docslight ComPDF Self-Hosted Deployment: https://www.compdf.com/self-hosted-deployment DottedSign Self-Hosted eSignature: https://www.dottedsign.com/integrations/Self-Hosted-eSignature/ Media Contact KDAN PR Team pr@kdanmobile.com

Steel plant denies using nuclear materials
ph.description: A STEEL manufacturing plant in Magalang, Pampanga, is not a "handler of nuclear materials." Lawyer Ryan Solano, spokesman of Chuanxing Steel Inc., issued the statement even as government authorities are yet to release their findings after the shutdown of one of the largest investors in town. “This company is not, and has never been, a handler of nuclear materials,” said Solano. “Where these materials appear at all, the established pathway in this industry is through purchased scrap feedstock — meaning the company did not add anything radioactive to its process,” stressed Solano. Solano explained that Chuanxing Steel Inc. "operates under an Environmental Compliance Certificate and current environmental permits, and we submit the regular self-monitoring reports that our regulators require." “We respect the legal process, and we are confident that when the evidence is examined carefully and measured against the law, it will show that the company has operated in good faith and in compliance with Philippine regulations,” the lawyer added. The lawyer said he is concerned most by the nearly 280 workers who draw income subsistence from the company. “What weighs on us most in this moment is not paperwork or process — it is our people. Nearly 280 workers, the overwhelming majority of them Filipino, walk through our gates each day, and behind every one of them is a family that depends on this plant to put food on the table,” lamented Solano. He asked the public to keep in mind that what has been made public so far are allegations under review, not proven findings, and that everyone involved is entitled to the presumption of innocence. “We will continue to cooperate openly while we work to protect our people and to see the facts fairly heard,” the statement added. “We understand why the word ‘radioactive’ alarms people, and we take that concern seriously — the safety of our workers and the surrounding community is not something we treat lightly." “The isotopes named — such as uranium-238, thorium-232 and their decay products — are Naturally Occurring Radioactive Materials, or NORM. They are present in ordinary rock, soil and mineral sands, and they are a well-documented, routine feature of scrap-based steelmaking worldwide, particularly in the heat-resistant linings and the components that channel molten steel,” the lawyer explained. On Sunday, July 19, the National Bureau of Investigation-Cybercrime and Forensic Management Investigation Unit (NBI-CFMIU) swooped down on the steel plant at Purok 1 in Barangay Navaling, Magalang, Pampanga. The raiding team, armed with a search warrant issued by the Cabanatuan City Regional Trial Court Branch 26, arrested four workers, although it was not established if radioactive materials had been "detected" inside the foreign firm. The four arrested were identified as Honggou Wang (plant director), Ma. Irish Casipe (corporate secretary), Lyu Yang, and Lyu Jingdong, all company workers. Magalang Mayor Malu Lacson has also allayed fears that the steel company had been using radioactive materials in the manufacturing of steel. “I wish to clarify that as of this date, the Municipality of Magalang has not yet received the Final Search Warrant Implementation Report, nor the official laboratory findings from the competent national government agencies,” said Lacson. Amid circulating reports that "confirmed nuclear waste" in Barangay Navaling, Lacson stressed that "public safety is non-negotiable. We owe our people the truth — complete, official, and supported by science. We will act on facts, not fear." “Matters involving the determination of radioactive materials and potential health risks must be established through scientific examination and official reports — not assumptions, speculation, or social media declarations,” Lacson said.

ph.title: Nike to tighten online sales in China
ph.description: NEW YORK — Nike is trying to lure back shoppers in China by controlling how its products are sold online, directing consumers to official Nike channels as the American sportswear giant continues to lose ground to domestic rivals. By restricting wholesale distributors’ online sales, the company aims to rebuild trust with Chinese shoppers and sell its products at full price, said Cathy Sparks, vice president and general manager of Greater China.Starting in January, key sportswear retailers in China will stop selling Nike’s clothing and shoes online, and will instead pivot to in-store sales, Sparks told Reuters. Online, the company’s products will be sold through new Nike-branded digital storefronts on the popular Chinese e-commerce platforms Tmall, JD.com and Douyin, along with Nike’s website and app.“Our marketplace has become so fragmented and cluttered,” said Sparks, a 25-year company veteran who was appointed to oversee Chinese operations earlier this year. “What consumers want is an experience that’s premium, true to the brand, trustworthy, and certainly connected between digital and physical.”The move runs counter to what most other major sports brands have done in China in recent years, expanding both online and in-store distribution to reach more customers in a market that has struggled for growth.Chinese consumers have spent less amid a broader economic slowdown, leading to more discounts from brands across the consumer spectrum seeking to prop up sales. China sales decline persists China, Nike’s third-largest market, remains a key source of concern for the world’s biggest sportswear brand. The e-commerce shift is part of a broader effort to revive growth.Sales in Greater China fell 17 percent on a ‌constant-currency basis ⁠in the fourth quarter, the company reported last month, steepening from a 10-percent decline in the previous quarter.Fast-rising domestic rivals Anta and Li Ning have chipped away at Nike’s market share, while foreign brands like On and Hoka have also surged.Nike’s China woes have reinforced for investors that CEO Elliott Hill’s turnaround strategy still faces significant obstacles. In his nearly two years at the helm of the company, Hill has pushed to refocus on ⁠sports, rebuild wholesale relationships in North America and introduce new products.The majority of Nike’s 16 store partners in China, which own and manage thousands of Nike stores, will stop selling online, a Nike spokesman said.Major Chinese sportswear retailers Topsports and Pou Sheng both fell in early trading after the announcement, with Pou Sheng shares down 10 percent and Topsports shares falling a record 23 percent, wiping around HK$3 billion ($382.70 million) from the firm’s market capitalization.Topsports, which generates 22 percent of its revenue from online sales of Nike products, said in an exchange filing on Wednesday it expects “significant” short-term negative impact. In its own filing, Pou Sheng said online sales of Nike’s products accounted for approximately 15 percent of its revenue.Both firms said they remain committed to continue working closely with Nike.Following local news reports about the potential e-commerce change in June, BNP Paribas senior analyst Laurent Vasilescu said the move would be a “strategic misstep” and would hand opportunities to competitors.“Nike doesn’t have a distribution problem in China and elsewhere. It has a product problem,” Vasilescu said in a research note in which he estimated the move could cost Nike $500 million to $1 billion in sales.Releasing products that are more relevant to Chinese consumers is also among Nike’s priorities, Sparks said. The company has appointed a vice president of local product creation in Greater China, she added.

ph.title: GSIS increases stake in Megawide to 9.5%
ph.description: STATE-RUN pension fund Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) has increased its stake in listed builder Megawide Construction Corp. to 9.5 percent after acquiring nearly 112 million shares through a series of block transactions. Megawide said in a statement on Wednesday that the state-owned pension fund had bought a total of 111.94 million common shares, raising its holdings to 191.71 million shares and making the GSIS one of the company's major local institutional investors. No financial figures were disclosed. Megawide Chairman and CEO Edgar Saavedra said the GSIS investment reflected confidence in the company's long-term strategy and participation in government infrastructure and housing projects. "The investment of GSIS reflects another vote of confidence in our vision of engineering a First-World Philippines, particularly through our participation in various government-initiated campaigns and public-private partnerships that aim to address critical social and transport infrastructure in the country," Saavedra said. He said the company continues to participate in the government's expanded Pambansang Pabahay Para sa Pilipino (4PH) program through the construction of socialized housing units using precast construction technology. "Specifically, this includes our participation in the construction of socialized housing units under the expanded 4PH program using mechanized and modernized techniques anchored on the precast system,” Saavedra said. “In addition, we are also rolling out several transport-centric developments that will modernize and organize public transport systems in the country, with the objective of enhancing safe and efficient travel and commuting." Megawide said it partnered with state-run Pag-IBIG Fund in September 2025, upon the endorsement of the Department of Socialized Housing and Urban Development, to build more than 7,000 socialized housing units under the government's expanded 4PH program. The company further said earnings had improved under its “4-D” strategy, with net income in the first quarter touching P265 million and its short-term obligations cut by around P7 billion. It also cited continued expansion of its precast construction and transport-centric development businesses. Earlier this month, Megawide declared a cash dividend of P0.145 per share, payable on Aug. 7, 2026, to stockholders on record as of July 23. Megawide shares on Wednesday slipped P0.07, or 1.67 percent, to close at P4.12 each amid a 1.04-percent drop for the benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange index.

bd.title: KDAN Open-Sources Core Products to Advance Enterprise AI Document Infrastructure and Data Sovereignty
bd.description: ComPDF and DottedSign are now available on GitHub with self-hosted deployment options, enabling enterprises to validate, deploy and scale AI-powered document workflows while maintaining control of sensitive data IRVINE, Calif. , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KDAN (TPEx: 7737), a global provider of AI document and data infrastructure, today announced the open-source release of core products ComPDF and DottedSign on GitHub, marking a major step in the company's global strategy to support enterprise AI adoption through open-source access and commercial licensing. Through this self-hosted, open-source model, KDAN aims to lower the barrier for enterprises seeking to adopt AI-powered document applications while creating a scalable path for commercial growth. The initiative responds to growing global demand for sovereign AI, self-hosted deployment and secure document infrastructure that allows organizations to retain control over sensitive information. Traditional enterprise software adoption often involves high implementation barriers, significant validation costs and lengthy procurement cycles. By open-sourcing core products, KDAN enables enterprise IT teams and developers to download core source code directly through GitHub and quickly deploy and use the solutions in self-hosted or private cloud environments without sending sensitive documents to third-party cloud services. KDAN's open-source projects adopt Open Source Initiative (OSI) approved licenses. The license terms, scope of use and commercial use conditions for each repository are subject to the LICENSE files published on GitHub. After completing validation, enterprises with advanced requirements for security governance, technical support, customized integration and long-term maintenance can upgrade to KDAN's enterprise commercial licensing offerings. These paid options include enterprise-grade security modules, global technical support, cross-system integration and long-term version maintenance, creating a full conversion path from open-source adoption to enterprise deployment. The strategy is especially relevant for financial services, manufacturing, government agencies and large enterprises that prioritize information security, compliance and data governance. By combining open-source access with commercial-grade enterprise services, KDAN is helping organizations accelerate AI innovation while maintaining compliance and control over their data. "KDAN is not competing with AI models. Instead, we serve as a 'charging station' that connects enterprise data with AI models," said Kenny Su, Founder and Chairman of KDAN. "Through core product open-sourcing and enterprise commercial licensing, we help enterprises train, access and apply document data more quickly, accurately and securely. By enabling organizations to maintain data autonomy, we are helping them build scalable AI document infrastructure while creating long-term business value for KDAN." KDAN continues to invest in product development across its two core product lines. ComPDF offers intelligent document parsing capabilities. In internal testing using the public OpenDataLab benchmark dataset and evaluation framework, ComPDF outperformed several mainstream open-source models in document recognition and table recognition tasks. The latest version of ComPDF achieved leading performance across multiple metrics, including Formula, Table, Text Parsing and Reading Order accuracy, demonstrating KDAN's long-term investment in AI document processing technology. Its open-source version provides core capabilities including document parsing, field extraction, API integration and self-hosted deployment for technical validation and basic implementation. The enterprise commercial licensing version further provides high-precision parsing, batch processing, access control, audit logs, system integration and long-term maintenance, supporting formal enterprise deployment and large-scale use. DottedSign's open-source version offers highly compatible APIs and a modular architecture, allowing enterprises to deploy the solution in self-hosted or private cloud environments and integrate it with existing ERP, HRM, CRM and other enterprise systems. Enterprises with advanced security, permission management, audit, customization and maintenance needs can upgrade to the enterprise commercial licensing version. Looking ahead, KDAN plans to extend this open-source and commercial licensing strategy to additional products and use cases, continuing to address long-term enterprise demand for data sovereignty and digital transformation. About KDAN KDAN (TPEx: 7737) is a global provider of AI document and data infrastructure for enterprises. pk.title: India's Dr Reddy's posts quarterly profit slump on semaglutide inventory costs
pk.description: HYDERABAD: Indian drugmaker Dr Reddy’s reported a smaller-than-expected quarterly profit on Wednesday, weighed by inventory and related costs associated with disruptions to semaglutide supply, the company said. Consolidated net profit tanked 68.7% to 4.44 billion rupees ($45.98 million) in the first quarter ending June 30. Analysts, on average, had estimated profit to fall to 7.22 billion rupees, according to data compiled by LSEG. Dr Reddy’s, which is counting on semaglutide as a major growth driver in India and a few global markets, said earlier this month that supplies of its generic version would remain unavailable in India and face disruptions in Canada until at least late October after an impurity issue in the active ingredient forced it to halt production of new batches. Semaglutide, the base ingredient in popular weight-loss drug Wegovy, is now off patent in India, opening the market to generic drugmakers. The company said on Wednesday that it made a provision of 2.39 billion rupees towards inventory and other associated costs related to the semaglutide disruptions during the quarter. The disruption is a setback to Dr Reddy’s ambitions in India’s fast-growing semaglutide market. Revenue from operations fell 5.5% to 81 billion rupees, below analysts’ average estimate of 81.6 billion rupees, hit by pricing pressure and increasing competition in its key U.S. market. Revenue from North America fell 35.3% to 22.05 billion srupees. The company has been grappling with declining sales of Lenalidomide, its generic version of Bristol Myers Squibb’s blockbuster cancer drug Revlimid, as more rivals enter the market after the drug lost exclusivity. Revenue from company’s India business rose 16.8% to 17.2 billion rupees.

pg.title: New AI toolkits to guide PNG, Pacific governments under Australian funding deal
pg.description: PAPUA NEW GUINEA and its Pacific neighbours will soon have access to purpose-built tools to help them weigh the risks and rewards of artificial intelligence (AI), after Australia confirmed a funding package worth almost PGK1.3 million (AUD420,000) for the region. Unveiled during Pacific Cyber Week and the Digital Transformation Summit in Port Moresby, the funding will support the rollout of governance and risk-management toolkits under Australia's Southeast Asia and Pacific Cyber Program. The technical development will be handled by Standards Australia. Australia's Special Envoy for the Pacific and Regional Affairs, Ewen McDonald, speaks at the Digital Transformation Summit in Port Moresby during the event attended by government and industry representatives. Picture supplied by the Australian High Commission. The toolkits are pitched at government officials, policymakers and practitioners, giving them a working understanding of what AI can offer and where the dangers lie, while promoting its ethical and responsible use across Pacific nations. Ewen McDonald, Australia's High Commissioner to Papua New Guinea and Special Envoy for the Pacific and Regional Affairs, said the technology held real potential to strengthen public service delivery across a region long hampered by distance and thin resources. "Artificial intelligence can help improve public services and address the challenges of distance and limited resources," he said. The initiative is also designed to give Pacific nations more influence in international talks on AI standards, as countries around the world scramble to put guardrails around the fast-developing technology. It comes at a time when Australia itself is tightening its own AI rulebook. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has flagged a National Framework of Australian Standards for AI, which will introduce mandatory requirements for large-scale AI infrastructure and development within the country. An Office of AI is also being established inside Australia's Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet to coordinate AI policy nationally. The Port Moresby summit further spotlighted a string of related projects, among them a planned PNG Digital Public Infrastructure Centre of Excellence, draft Pacific Digital and AI Principles, expanded online safety measures, and a National eSafety Symposium. Canberra reaffirmed its intent to keep working with Pacific partners on strengthening digital infrastructure, improving cyber resilience, building digital capability, and ensuring the region has a say in shaping how AI is governed globally. Australia's Ambassador for Cyber Affairs and Critical Technology, Jessica Hunter, said the guidance being developed would reflect the realities on the ground in Pacific nations rather than importing standards wholesale from elsewhere. "Responsible AI adoption requires practical and accessible guidance," Ms Hunter said. "The toolkits will help Pacific partners assess risks, strengthen governance and shape AI use in ways that reflect local needs, values and aspirations."

ae.title: AMD pours up to $5B into Anthropic — but the payoff waits until 2027
ae.description: AMD is committing as much as $5 billion to Anthropic. In turn, Anthropic will funnel a sizable share of that cash straight back to AMD to buy chips. Yes, it works like a loop — because it is one. The chipmaker unveiled the arrangement on Wednesday, and its structure reveals far more than the top-line figure. Per the announcement and an earlier report from The Wall Street Journal, Anthropic plans to roll out up to 2 gigawatts of AMD's Instinct MI450 GPUs, powered by AMD's new Helios rack-scale system. The money moves in a circle This is the piece worth pausing on. AMD isn't merely offloading hardware to Anthropic. It's putting money into the very firm purchasing that hardware, and then turning around to buy that firm's product. Bundled into the deal is a "multi-year engineering collaboration," and AMD will use Anthropic's Claude throughout its own software development, engineering and product development. In other words, AMD supplies the chips, bankrolls the purchaser, and then becomes a customer of the purchaser's model. Every arrow loops back to both parties. "By partnering with AMD across the stack, we are securing the capacity we need and optimizing it for training and serving Claude," said Tom Brown, Anthropic cofounder and chief compute officer, in the press release. Anthropic is buying compute from everyone None of this is an isolated move. Anthropic has by now inked AI infrastructure agreements with Google, Broadcom and Amazon. It has also struck data center deals with SpaceX and TeraWulf — and there's chatter that a pact with Meta could follow. Put simply, this is a company scooping up capacity from anyone prepared to offer it. What makes the AMD deal notable isn't its size. It's that AMD is simultaneously the one cutting the investment check. When the chips actually show up Don't count on any of this going live anytime soon. The pair intends to bring the first gigawatt online in the first half of 2027, layering it atop the SpaceX and TeraWulf data center deals Anthropic already holds. No public timeline has been set for the second gigawatt. Keep your eye on the calendar rather than the dollar amount. The benchmark AMD should be measured against is that opening gigawatt arriving in the first half of 2027. Beyond that, it's all just a pledge with a press release attached.

sa.title: مؤسسة براند فايناس العالمية: أرامكو تحقق زيادة في علامتها التجارية بنسبة 2.3 في كأس العالم 2026
sa.description:
كشفت مؤسسة «براند فاينانس» العالمية عن تحليلها لأداء العلامات التجارية الراعية لبطولة كأس العالم 2026، التي استضافتها الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية وكندا والمكسيك، مسلطةً الضوء على حجم المكاسب التي حققتها الشركات المشاركة عقب إسدال الستار على البطولة.

وأظهر التقرير أن شركة «أرامكو» سجلت نمواً في قيمة علامتها التجارية بنسبة 2.3%، لتحتل المرتبة الرابعة بين الرعاة الرسميين الـ21 للبطولة، متجاوزةً متوسط النمو المسجل بين الشركات الراعية، والذي بلغ 1.6%.

كما تفوقت أرامكو في معدل نمو علامتها التجارية على عدد من كبرى الشركات العالمية الراعية، من بينها «كوكاكولا»، و«فيزا»، و«ماكدونالدز»، و«بنك أوف أمريكا»، في مؤشر يعكس الأثر الإيجابي لمشاركتها في الحدث الرياضي الأكبر عالمياً.

ويؤكد التقرير استمرار الحضور العالمي المتنامي لأرامكو، بعدما عززت البطولة من مكانة علامتها التجارية على المستوى الدولي، لترسخ حضورها بين أبرز العلامات التجارية العالمية المستفيدة من كأس العالم 2026.

sa.title: مؤسسة براند فايناس العالمية: أرامكو تحقق زيادة في علامتها التجارية بنسبة 2.3 في كأس العالم2026
sa.description:
كشفت مؤسسة براند فايناس العالمية، تحليلا حول العائدات الخاصة ببطولة كأس العالم2026، وذلك بعد انتهاء البطولة، التي أقيمت في الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية وكندا والمكسيك.

وحققت شركة أرامكو زيادة في قيمة علامتها التجارية، بنسبة 2.3، وهي رابع أعلي نسبة بين جميع الرعاة الرسميين الـ 21 للبطولة التي أقيمت في أمريكا وكندا والمكسيك خلال الفترة الماضية.

وتفوقت أرامكو علي عدد من الشركات، حيث تجاوزة المتوسط البالغ 1.6%، لتكون متفوقة بذلك علي العديد من الشركات الكبري مثل كوكاكولا، وفيزا، بالإضافة إلى ماكدونالدز وبنك أوف أمريكا.

وتواصل شركة أرامكو التفوق علي العديد من الشركات العالمية في كافة المجالات، حيث أظهرت نجاحا كبيرا خلال بطولة كأس العالم الأخيرة، لتواصل تفوقها عالميا في كل الأمور.

sa.title: فرنسا تسجل 5764 وفاة إضافية خلال موجة حر هي الأشد منذ صيف 2003
sa.description:
أعلنت الوكالة الوطنية للصحة العامة في فرنسا تسجيل 5764 وفاة إضافية خلال موجة الحر الشديد التي اجتاحت البلاد بين 17 يونيو و2 يوليو، في أعلى زيادة بمعدلات الوفيات منذ موجة الحر التاريخية التي شهدتها البلاد عام 2003.

وأوضحت الوكالة أن نحو نصف الوفيات الإضافية سُجلت خلال ثلاثة أيام فقط، بين 25 و27 يونيو، مشيرة إلى أن الارتفاع في معدلات الوفاة شمل جميع الفئات العمرية بدءًا من 15 عامًا، مع زيادة أكثر وضوحًا بين الأشخاص الذين تجاوزوا 45 عامًا، وهو ما وصفته بأنه تطور غير مسبوق، رغم عدم إمكانية الربط بشكل قاطع بين جميع الوفيات وموجة الحر حتى الآن.

ضحايا الحر في فرنسا

وأضافت أن موجة الحر، التي اتسمت بأنها مبكرة وطويلة الأمد، أثرت على نحو 98.5% من سكان فرنسا، وشملت 92 مقاطعة، بالتزامن مع فترة النشاط المدرسي والمهني، ما زاد من تداعياتها على السكان.



وأظهرت البيانات أن نحو ثلثي الوفيات الإضافية كانت بين الأشخاص الذين تبلغ أعمارهم 75 عامًا فأكثر، وهي الفئة الأكثر عرضة لمضاعفات الحرارة الشديدة بسبب هشاشة أوضاعها الصحية.

مواجهة موجة الحر

وأثارت أرقام الوفيات جدلًا سياسيًا في فرنسا، إذ وجهت أحزاب المعارضة انتقادات للحكومة متهمة إياها بعدم الاستعداد الكافي لمواجهة موجة الحر، في وقت شهدت فيه البلاد موجة حر ثالثة خلال منتصف يوليو.

وللمقارنة، سجلت فرنسا خلال صيف عام 2025 نحو 5700 وفاة مرتبطة بالحرارة الشديدة، وفق الأرقام النهائية الصادرة عن هيئة الصحة الوطنية.

dz.title: سيدي بلعباس : تسجيل 8 حرائق غابية أتت على أكثر من 500 هكتار
dz.description: الجهوي : سجلت المحافظة الولائية للغابات بسيدي بلعباس منذ شهر ماي 141 تدخلا عبر مختلف مناطق الولاية من بينها ثمانية حرائق غابية أتت على أكثر من 500 هکتار، وذلك منذ بداية موجة الحر خلال شهر جويلية الجاري، كما سجلت ذات المصالح 79 تدخلا مس المحاصيل الزراعية خلال الفترة الممتدة من 21 ماي إلى غاية 19 جويلية. هذا وأشادت المحافظة الولائية للغابات بالمساهمة للمواطنين و المشاركة في إخماد الحرائق المسجلة بالولاية إلى جانب المصالح الأمنية المشتركة ، إلى جانب جهود أعواد الحماية المدنية وأفراد الجيش الشعبي الوطني و الدرك الوطني ، حيث أكدت المحافظة أن هذا التكاثف يعكس روح المسؤولية الجماعية لحماية الثروة الغابية. و من جهتها دعت مديرية الحماية المدنية لولاية سيدي بلعباس المواطنين إلى التحلي باليقظة و الإلتزام بتدابير الوقاية لتجنب حرائق الغابات، خاصة في ظل موجات الحر و إرتفاع درجات الحرارة،و الإمتناع التام عن إقامة حفلات الشواء أو إشعال النار داخل الفضاءات الغابية،و عدم رمي أعقاب السجائر أو المخلفات الزجاجية و المواد المشتعلة في الغابات أو الطرق المجاورة لها، إلى جانب القيام بتقليم و تزبير الأشجار القريبة من المساكن المتاخمة للغابات،و ضرورة الإتصال السريع بمصالح الحماية المدنية أو الجهات المعنية عند ملاحظة أي دخان أو سلوك مشبوه،مذكرة بصرامة القوانين الجديدة التي تطبق عقوبات قاسية جداً ضد المتسببين عمداً في إتلاف الثروة الغابية

dz.title: سعيدة.. الجهود متواصلة لإخماد حريق غابة سيدي مرزوق
dz.description: الجهوي : تشهد غابة سيدي مرزوق بولاية سعيدة منذ اندلاع الحريق الغابي حالة استنفار قصوى، حيث تتواصل عمليات الإخماد بوتيرة مكثفة بمشاركة مختلف الأجهزة والهيئات المجندة، في سباق مع الزمن للسيطرة على ألسنة اللهب والحد من انتشارها نحو المساحات الغابية والمناطق المجاورة. وقد وقف والي ولاية سعيدة، أمومن مرموري، ميدانيا على سير عمليات التدخل، حيث أشرف إلى غاية ساعات متأخرة من الليل على تنسيق جهود الفرق المتدخلة، مع المتابعة المستمرة لتطورات الوضع وتقييم فعالية الوسائل البشرية والمادية المسخرة، بما يسمح باتخاذ القرارات المناسبة وفقا لمستجدات الميدان. وعرفت عمليات الإخماد مشاركة واسعة لمصالح الحماية المدنية ومحافظة الغابات، إلى جانب أفراد الجيش الوطني الشعبي والدرك الوطني، فضلا عن مختلف المصالح المعنية، في إطار تنسيق محكم يهدف إلى تطويق بؤر النيران ومنع امتدادها، خاصة في ظل الظروف المناخية الصعبة التي ساهمت في تعقيد مهمة أعوان التدخل. كما سجلت هذه العمليات حضورا لافتا للمواطنين و المجتمع المدني وعدد من الجمعيات الذين ساهموا في دعم جهود الإطفاء، سواء من خلال تقديم المساعدات اللوجستية أو المشاركة في العمليات الميدانية، في صورة تعكس روح التضامن والتكاتف لمواجهة هذا الظرف الاستثنائي. وأكد والي الولاية خلال متابعته الميدانية على ضرورة الإبقاء على أعلى درجات التعبئة، مع تسخير جميع الإمكانيات المتاحة وتعزيز التنسيق بين مختلف المتدخلين، حفاظا على سلامة المواطنين وممتلكاتهم، وحماية الثروة الغابية من الخسائر التي قد تخلفها الحرائق. ولا تزال عمليات الإخماد والمراقبة متواصلة إلى غاية القضاء النهائي على جميع بؤر الحريق وتأمين المناطق المتضررة، وسط تجند كامل لمختلف المصالح المختصة لضمان عودة الوضع إلى طبيعته في أقرب الآجال.

zw.title: Charamba strike hands Chicken Inn victory over TelOne
zw.description: Langalakhe Mabena at Luveve Stadium Chicken Inn secured a hard-fought 1-0 victory over TelOne FC in a Castle Lager Premier Soccer League Week 24 encounter at Luveve Stadium this afternoon, with Michael Charamba's first-half strike proving the difference. Charamba's superb 42nd-minute volley settled the contest as the GameCocks held firm in the second half to deny the visitors an equaliser and collect maximum points. The hosts had the perfect opportunity to take an early lead in the 10th minute after being awarded a penalty, but George Majika's spot-kick was saved by TelOne goalkeeper Takudzwa Chikosi, who guessed correctly to keep the scores level. TelOne almost punished Chicken Inn four minutes later when they earned a free-kick on the edge of the penalty area, but veteran midfielder Silas Songani failed to hit the target, sending his effort wide. Chicken Inn continued to create chances and came close again in the 31st minute when Majika delivered a teasing cross into the box, only for Innocent Masiwa to head wide. The breakthrough eventually arrived three minutes before the interval. Charamba reacted quickest to a loose ball on the edge of the box and unleashed a first-time volley that flew beyond Chikosi to give the GameCocks a deserved lead. TelOne responded with a double substitution at the start of the second half, introducing Frank Makarati for Prince Milanzi and Chris Mangwende for Nkosiyabo Masilela in search of a way back into the match. Chicken Inn nearly doubled their advantage in the 53rd minute, but striker Man Ykre Dangmo Ngnowa Hapmo dragged his effort wide. The visitors introduced Blessing Matebeck for Songani in the 58th minute with the move making them to enjoyed more possession as they searched for an equaliser. Chicken Inn freshened up their attack in the 77th minute, bringing on Rahim Katinji for Hapmo and Edmore Chirambadare for Masiwa. Despite TelOne's sustained pressure in the closing stages, the GameCocks remained resolute at the back. Brendon Rendo had an opportunity to seal the result in the 84th minute after connecting with Chirambadare's corner-kick, but his effort sailed over the crossbar. Charamba, the match winner, made way for Vasili Kawe in the 86th minute, and the substitute nearly marked his cameo with a goal three minutes later but failed to convert from inside the penalty area. Chicken Inn comfortably saw out the remaining minutes to claim all three points from a closely contested encounter at Luveve Stadium. Team line-ups Chicken Inn FC: Donovan Fungai Benard, Alex Mumbango, Sefu Louisom Ngongo, Farai Tsinakwadi, Man Ykre Dangmo Ngnowa Hapmo (Rahim Katinji, 77), Itai Mabunu, Brendon Rendo, Thulani Joseph, George Majika (Chinika, 70), Innocent Masiwa (Edmore Chirambadare), 77), Michael Charamba (Vasili Kawe, 86). TelOne FC: Takudzwa Chikosi, Admire Dzumbunu (captain), Allan Chapinduka, Nqobizitha Masuku, Jerry Chipangura, Silas Songani (Blessing Matebeck, 58), Innocent Mucheneka (Bruno Mtigo,80) , Chelsea Nyakope, Evans Katema, Nkosiyabo Masilela (Chris Mangwende, 45), Prince Milanzi (Frank Makarati, 45).

zw.title: Egodini project a “headache” – says BCC, as contractor fails to meet deadlines since 2016
zw.description: Mkhululi Ncube themkhust@gmail.com THE Bulawayo City Council (BCC) is weighing options after Terracotta Trading (Pvt) Limited, which was awarded tender to develop the former Egodini taxi rank into a modern mall and regional transport hub has repeatedly failed to set meet deadlines since taking over the site in 2016. The company was awarded the tender in 2015 to transform the area but eleven years down the line a section of the project has been opened. Responding to questions during a media engagement at the Council Chambers on Wednesday, Acting Town Clerk, Mrs Sikhangele Zhou, said the South African company missed the July 1, 2026 deadline given by council. “Egodini project continues to be a headache to us, for starters they are out of time, and they changed their shareholding structure. They had promised that the changes will strengthen them so that they will be able to resume work,” she said. “They were set to resume works on the first of July according to what they had promised us but they have failed to do so. We have put them on terms, that is, to ask them to explain themselves so that we may consider our options going forward, if it still fails. “The city had thought that there was hope with the restructuring of Terracotta. We thought we could give the new structure a chance to complete the project but we were disappointed when they didn’t return.” Mrs Zhou said the council was watching the company closely and action to be taken will be determined by the reaction. Stakeholders have said the non-completion of the project was responsible for the chaos in the city centre with multiple illegal pick up points by kombis who refuse to use the opened section.

cm.title: Capital : la SIC prépare une augmentation de 151,8 milliards FCFA à son budget actuel
cm.description: © DR Les actionnaires de la Société immobilière du Cameroun (SIC) examineront un projet d'augmentation de capital de 151,8 milliards de FCFA, adossé à 11 terrains couvrant près de 407 hectares. Si l'opération est approuvée, le capital social passerait de 75 milliards à 226,8 milliards de FCFA. La Société immobilière du Cameroun (SIC) franchit une nouvelle étape dans le renforcement de sa structure financière. Convoqués en Assemblée générale mixte le 30 juillet prochain à Yaoundé, les actionnaires devront notamment se prononcer sur un projet d'augmentation du capital social fondé sur l'apport en nature de terrains attribués par l'État. L'opération repose sur la valorisation de 11 parcelles réparties dans les régions du Centre, du Littoral, de l'Adamaoua, du Nord, de l'Extrême-Nord et de l'Ouest. Leur valeur a été arrêtée à 151,821 milliards de FCFA, un montant qui viendrait s'ajouter au capital actuel de 75 milliards de FCFA pour le porter à environ 226,8 milliards de FCFA. Les états financiers arrêtés au 31 décembre 2025 précisent que ces terrains ont déjà été transférés à la SIC en apport au capital par l'État. Toutefois, ils n'avaient pas encore été évalués ni inscrits dans les comptes de l'entreprise à la clôture de l'exercice. Leur évaluation constitue ainsi le préalable à leur comptabilisation au bilan et à la concrétisation de l'opération. Outre ce dossier stratégique, l'Assemblée générale ordinaire examinera les états financiers 2025, les rapports du conseil d'administration et du commissaire aux comptes, avant de statuer sur l'affectation du résultat, le quitus aux dirigeants et la rémunération des administrateurs pour l'exercice 2026. La partie extraordinaire portera également sur la désignation d'un commissaire aux apports et la délégation de pouvoirs au conseil d'administration pour la mise en œuvre de l'opération. Cet article Capital : la SIC prépare une augmentation de 151,8 milliards FCFA à son budget actuel est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
